jobs.title: Early Childhood Educator
jobs.short: Plan and deliver early childhood curriculum for children aged 3–5.
jobs.details: We are looking for a nurturing Lead Teacher with minimum 2 years experience in early childhood education. Responsibilities include lesson planning, parent communication and child assessment.

jobs.title: Childcare Assistant
jobs.short: Support Lead Teachers with daily care routines and classroom activities.
jobs.details: Assist with supervision, meal times and play-based learning. Good communication and a caring manner required. Early childhood coursework or equivalent experience preferred.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.short: Help keep our daycare clean, safe, and welcoming on weekdays.
jobs.details: We are hiring a part-time Cleaner for weekday shifts. Responsibilities include cleaning classrooms, washrooms, common areas, and helping maintain a safe, sanitary environment for children and staff. Reliability, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic are required.
